material_findings.summary: LOCAL_PARENT_CONFLICT and ALIGNMENT_GAINED are NOT_EVALUABLE for all 7,116 eligible windows because the frozen 2H parent states have no evaluated LOCATION or MOTION direction.
26,516 of 56,928 rule attempts are NOT_EVALUABLE; the separate frozen source-axis not-evaluable marker census is 13,993.
Only 615 of 4,072 target 15M parent resolutions (15.103143%) carry a non-empty parent level set.
The authoritative PRIMARY_OVERLAP_PLUS_1 variant produces 20 connected components from 1,779 centre-time occurrences, with maximum component size 166.
1,456 occurrences are MATERIAL_SENSITIVITY and 323 STRUCTURALLY_UNSTABLE across the three frozen overlap variants; none classify ROBUST under the frozen comparison rule.
